ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-15: Blocks Quote from being Presented or Accepted while Credit Limit is exceeded and not approved by Finance. Quote remains locked at Approved status until Finance reviews.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Credit_Limit_Exceeded__c, NOT(Credit_Finance_Approved__c), Opportunity.Account.Active_Quote_Count__c > 1, OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Presented"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Accepted") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This quote exceeds the account credit limit and is pending Finance review. The quote cannot be presented or accepted until Finance approves the credit limit.
